# Communications Suite

A comprehensive toolkit for all company communications needs.

## Overview

This playbook combines multiple communication capabilities:
- Internal communications (3P updates, newsletters, etc.)
- Formatting helpers for consistent styling

## Usage

1. Identify the communication type needed
2. The appropriate referenced skill will be invoked automatically
3. Follow the specific guidelines for that communication type

## Related Capabilities

This suite integrates with referenced playbooks for specialized tasks.
